证券发行主体ID（基金/指数/期货用）

fields.expr_tpl:
CASE
  WHEN {a}.reg_capital REGEXP '^[0-9,]+(\\.[0-9]+)?(万元|万元人民币)$'
    THEN CAST(REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM({a}.reg_capital), '(万元人民币|万元)$', ''), ',', '') AS DECIMAL(20,4))
  WHEN {a}.reg_capital REGEXP '^[0-9,]+(\\.[0-9]+)?(亿元|亿元人民币)$'
    THEN CAST(REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM({a}.reg_capital), '(亿元人民币|亿元)$', ''), ',', '') AS DECIMAL(20,4)) * 10000
  WHEN {a}.reg_capital REGEXP '^[0-9,]+(\\.[0-9]+)?元$'
    THEN CAST(REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM({a}.reg_capital), '元$', ''), ',', '') AS DECIMAL(20,4)) / 10000
  ELSE NULL
END
fields.expr:
CASE
  WHEN T1.reg_capital REGEXP '^[0-9,]+(\\.[0-9]+)?(万元|万元人民币)$'
    THEN CAST(REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(T1.reg_capital), '(万元人民币|万元)$', ''), ',', '') AS DECIMAL(20,4))
  WHEN T1.reg_capital REGEXP '^[0-9,]+(\\.[0-9]+)?(亿元|亿元人民币)$'
    THEN CAST(REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(T1.reg_capital), '(亿元人民币|亿元)$', ''), ',', '') AS DECIMAL(20,4)) * 10000
  WHEN T1.reg_capital REGEXP '^[0-9,]+(\\.[0-9]+)?元$'
    THEN CAST(REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(T1.reg_capital), '元$', ''), ',', '') AS DECIMAL(20,4)) / 10000
  ELSE NULL
END
